title: fight.shots/1 (docs/architecture/shots.md)
description: data/fight/shots.json: energy blasts in flight (sim/core/shots.gd): the cap on live shots, the arrival bound of a seeking shot, the fighter's contact size, and each kind's speed (units a tick), radius, trade power, plain damage and flight times. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore; the kinds are an open table of closed records.

arriveTicks.description: A seeking shot arrives within this many ticks.

chest.description: A fighter's centre above his feet.

bodyR.description: A fighter's radius for a shot's contact.

kinds.description: The kinds of shot, by name.

speed.description: Units a tick (a minimum for a seeking shot).

r.description: Its radius, for contact and trades.

dmg.description: What a plain hit does (a placeholder until the director's blasts set their own).

lifeTicks.description: How long a straight shot flies.

lobArc.description: A lobbed shot's height above the straight line.
